natalie-epstein.text: "My number one priority is clear: safety on every campus." Says school safety "needs to be proactive, not reactive. And safety cannot stop when the school day ends."

source.title: Natalie Epstein for SUSD Governing Board, Area 1 (campaign site)

natalie-epstein.text: "We need anti-bullying policies that are consistently enforced, and strong access to counselors and support for children who need it."

source.title: Natalie Epstein for SUSD Governing Board, Area 1 (campaign site)

natalie-epstein.text: "The perspective of a mother belongs at that table. Parents need a voice in the education of their kids — and I will make sure they are never dismissed."

source.title: Natalie Epstein for SUSD Governing Board, Area 1 (campaign site)

natalie-epstein.text: "I believe in transparency, accountability, and asking the difficult questions when something isn't working."

source.title: Natalie Epstein for SUSD Governing Board, Area 1 (campaign site)

larry-grable.text: Wants "clear districtwide expectations for behavior, consistent interventions and consequences, and regular reporting to the board," citing a 2025 district survey where fewer than half of students said classmates behave so teachers can teach.

source.title: The Signal: Larry Grable | Reasons to Run for School Board (letter, 2026-09-23)

larry-grable.text: In Ballotpedia survey, proposes an Advanced Learning Pathway so students who master grade-level standards get advanced instruction "rather than asking them to wait for formal GATE identification in third grade."

source.title: Ballotpedia: Larry Grable (2026 Candidate Connection survey)

larry-grable.text: Proposes regular program reviews of cost and outcomes: "we cannot simply continue spending because 'that's how we've always done it.' Every dollar should have a purpose."

source.title: Ballotpedia: Larry Grable (2026 Candidate Connection survey)

larry-grable.text: Wants age-appropriate AI standards covering classroom use, academic integrity and student privacy; AI "should enhance education, not replace teachers, student thinking or original work."

source.title: The Signal: Larry Grable | Reasons to Run for School Board (letter, 2026-09-23)

larry-grable.text: Says the board should set a baseline and judge the new enVision Mathematics curriculum using i-Ready growth, common assessments and CAASPP results, and better support gifted and twice-exceptional students.

source.title: The Signal: Larry Grable | Reasons to Run for School Board (letter, 2026-09-23)

larry-grable.text: Pledges regular town-hall-style meetings across Trustee Area 1 rather than waiting for parents to come to board meetings.

source.title: The Signal: Larry Grable | Reasons to Run for School Board (letter, 2026-09-23)

larry-grable.text: Endorsed by the California Democratic Party, LA County Democratic Party, Santa Clarita Valley Democrats, and Iron Workers Locals 416 and 433.

source.title: Ballotpedia: Larry Grable (2026 Candidate Connection survey)

kevin-kim.text: Says he saw "an administration that was not being challenged and used to having their decisions rubber stamped"; wants board members who will "challenge and study the different proposals made by administrators."

source.title: The Signal: Kevin Kim | Establishing the Culture (letter, 2026-09-25)

kevin-kim.text: "Then we can empower teachers to do what they do best, teach"; says administrators should have clear objectives but freedom to choose how to meet them.

source.title: The Signal: Kevin Kim | Establishing the Culture (letter, 2026-09-25)

kevin-kim.text: Says his commitment to these principles "has earned me the endorsement of the Saugus Teachers Association and the California School Employees Association."

source.title: The Signal: Kevin Kim | Establishing the Culture (letter, 2026-09-25)

kevin-kim.text: (2023) In a board-vacancy application: "Classrooms should be a place where it is safe to have discussions, where people of various backgrounds and beliefs should feel safe to send their children."

source.title: KHTS: Six Candidates Vie For Open Saugus School Board Seat (2023-10-23)
